description: This script automates continuous integration tasks for a project, including protocol generation checks, running builds, linters, tests on Linux and macOS, and specific workflows for different environments. It manages tasks such as diff checking, running commands, and conditional execution based on environment and changes.

methods.name: log_step
methods.description: Prints a formatted log message for a step in the CI process.

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Logs and executes a given command or function, used to sequence CI steps.

methods.name: run_protocol_ci_mirror
methods.description: Generates protocol files, compares diffs, and ensures tracked outputs are updated.

methods.name: has_native_swift_changes
methods.description: Checks if native Swift files in specific directories have changed compared to main or previous commit.

methods.name: run_linux_ci_mirror
methods.description: Executes CI steps for Linux including build, tests, linting, and protocol generation.

methods.name: run_macos_ci_mirror
methods.description: Executes CI steps for macOS, including linting, building, and testing, conditioned on environment and changes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that runs Linux and macOS CI workflows.
